flags.flag: OCEANE 2029 soft call / leverage target dependency
flags.detail: YE2026 ~1.65x leverage target and the EUR 500m buyback were sized on conversion of the OCEANE 2029 (debt component EUR 362m). Soft call possible from Oct-2026 at 130% of par (CFO: ~EUR 21.5). After the 28-May-2026 adjustment (6,256.8564 shares per bond; 3,800 bonds = 23,776,054 shares) implied conversion price ~EUR 15.98 and 130% trigger ~EUR 20.78 [calc]. Last close EUR 21.26 (9-Oct-2026), 2026 low EUR 20.98 (21-Sep): cushion ~2% [calc]. Exact trigger test (averaging period) not in sources. If no conversion, YE leverage ~0.2x above target [e]. Bondholder put 22-Sep-2027.

flags.flag: First negative H1 FCF in sample; FCF bridge
flags.detail: H1 FCF EUR -30.1m vs +31m H1 2025 and +55.5m H1 2024 (H1 2023 EUR 17m): swing EUR -61.1m [calc] = CF before fin/tax +33.9m, net capex -47.3m, WC -51.0m, net interest +14.2m, tax -7.1m, leases -3.8m [calc]. Management: timing only; nearly all FCF generated in H2; FY MSD growth reaffirmed.

flags.flag: Working capital: inventory build and DSO deterioration
flags.detail: WC change EUR -164.0m (vs -113m): flat-linen and workwear inventory build plus DSO 57 days (vs 54). CFO: "a couple of days", ~60 days group level, not to over-read. Credit-risk vigilance strengthened in Mexico. Securitisation programme (France, up to EUR 200m, since Jun-2023) and supplier-finance programme exist; utilisation not disclosed in indexed prose.

Leverage 2.09x at 30-Jun-2026 vs 1.75x Dec-2025 and 1.92x Jun-2025; net debt +EUR 650m in H1 (buyback 466.8m, dividend 105.6m, M&A 36m, negative FCF). CFO: 2026 "not exactly a normative year". Covenant <3.75x (RCF/USPP).

flags.flag: Mexico tender reset and impairment indicators
flags.detail: Mexico federal healthcare tender re-run as multi-lot: 50% of volume lost (~EUR 2m/month from June; ~EUR 14m 2026); not in forecast to recover. Months earlier the tender win was "massive... super profitable" and Q1 2026 Mexico organic was ~+16%. SR: impairment indicators at Mexico (tenders not renewed) and Chile (EBITDA <90% of budget) CGUs; tests showed no impairment.

flags.flag: Guidance credibility versus CMD and LatAm commentary
flags.detail: FY2025 adj EBIT margin flat at 16.0% vs "slightly up" guided; adj EBIT grew slower than revenue in FY2025 and H1 2026 vs CMD target of faster; organic below ~4% CMD target in 2025 and guided below again in 2026; LatAm 2026 margin guided flat-to-up in March, -180bp in H1 with further H2 decline expected; German healthcare contract restated from ~EUR 30m/yr to ~EUR 20m additional revenue in 2027; 2027 energy saving cut from EUR 10-15m to slightly below EUR 10m.

H1 2025 restated under IFRS 3 (Neutral PPA; NI 152.5m published -> 152.4m); FY2024 restated under IFRS 3 (Carsan, Wasned, Ernst); IFRS 9/7 amendment cut opening 2026 cash by EUR 1.8m (non-retrospective); IFRS 18 from 2027. FY2025 non-current income included ~EUR 25m insurance compensation; FY2025 IFRS 2 EUR 46m incl. one-offs; H1 2026 IFRS 2 down to 16.3m; French 2025 surtax gone (ETR 27.7% vs 29.3%); H1 net interest paid -EUR 14.2m from coupon timing after early refinancing.

SR: early refinancing in Nov-2025 of the EUR 600m bond originally maturing Mar-2026. FY2025 call: early repayment of a EUR 350m bond maturing Feb-2026 and a EUR 350m 3.375% Sep-2031 issue. Cannot reconcile from prose; flag for capital-structure workstream.

flags.flag: Transcription errors in H1 2026 call (use SR)
flags.detail: EBITDA margin "35.7%" (SR 34.7%); adj EBIT "EUR 317 million" (SR 370.0m); leverage "2.9x" (SR 2.09x); "nearly 180 million share" repurchased (466.8m/26.25 = ~17.8m [calc]); net income "+3.3%" (SR +7.3%); revenue "EUR 245.1 billion"; LatAm margin 30.8% (SR 30.7%).

flags.flag: Management changes (not discussed on the call)
flags.detail: Effective 5-Sep-2026: Xavier Martire reappointed Chairman of Management Board and Louis Guyot reappointed (4 years); Yann Michel (Group COO) joins Management Board; Matthieu Lecharny did not seek reappointment and steps back from Group roles end-2026; from 1-Jul-2026 three new Deputy COOs; Andreas Schneider left as Deputy COO.
BWSA crossed above/below/above 20% of voting rights (Feb/Mar/Jun-2026); CPPIB fell below 10% (Feb) then 5% (Jul); Invesco above 5% (Mar) and 10% (Jul); Wellington around 5%.

Close peaked EUR 28.20 on 3-Jul-2026; buyback completed 9-Jul-2026; -5.68% on results day; EUR 21.26 on 9-Oct-2026 (-24.6% from peak, -18.4% from pre-results close) [calc]. No volume data in getStockPrices to assess buyback support.

No Elis document between Aug-2025 and Jan-2026 (no Q3 2025 revenue release or call); no Q1/Q3 sales calls after Jan-2024; consensus limited to quarterly revenue; regional EUR revenue and "Others" only in non-indexed tables.
